native_build: Zig 0.17.0, ReleaseFast; official Zig archive verified by parent

throughput.reply_policy: both enabled, discard replies without capture allocation
throughput.grapheme_mode: both C/Go defaults off; graphemes fixture explicitly enables 2027 on both
throughput.history: budgeted uses same nominal2000lines/256KiB, NOT equal retained state; Phosphorserializedlogical lines vsnativephysical/page accounting. Record actual retained row counts per sample. none is the matched zero-history control.
throughput.inputs: pre-generated before timing; SHA256 identical across builds, phases and chunk sizes

memory.metrics: Go HeapAlloc delta and process RSS delta, divided by terminal count; native Go-wrapper heap excludes native allocations
memory.GC: same two collections before baseline and after all terminal initialization, no forced scavenging
memory.equal_history_validation: TestEqualHistoryMemoryFixture compares all 100 retained physical rows plus screen/styles/modes before and after both compactions
memory.notes: Different terminal counts expose allocator/RSS amortization. Heap stable across baseline/candidate; no forced page scavenging.

go_idle.policy: library defaults; charm uses 4MiB parser buffer and two 10,000-line scrollback buffers; policies and feature sets differ from Phosphor and vt10x

go_throughput.metric: wall MB/s, decimal megabytes as reported by Go benchmarks
go_throughput.policy: library defaults; different history limits, protocol bounds and feature coverage; measured throughput is not proof of feature equivalence

source_manifest_note: Production hash is shared by all candidate samples; driver phases are recorded separately. Final driver also adds the equal-history fixture validation and helpers without changing timed Write paths.
audit_corrections: Native optional continuation tracking was64KiB; default0 is now used outside checkpoint tests. Trackerinit reserves4KiB, so previous RSS ratios included optional checkpoint storage.
Phosphor now uses WithReply(io.Discard) in timed paths; native has equivalent discard callback.
Retained rows reported; additional history-disabled control disambiguates equal budgets from equal work.
Inputs, byte totals and geometry recorded; no empty selector result may exit successfully.
Native source provenance constant updated to verified6ba HEAD.
Graphics/GUI and long oversized OSC/DCS payloads are excluded; no universal compatibility or overall-fastest claim.
go_comparison_note: Separate library-default Go harness; reply, history, parser bounds and feature coverage differ. No equal-feature or cross-engine RSS inference.
